translations.web: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.
translations.bsb: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured the distance from gateway to gateway to be a hundred cubits.
translations.kjv: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
